C0934.title: JD Finance Joins Police to Dismantle Anti-Collection Black-Market Gang
C0934.summary: In January 2024, the Public Security Bureau of Yunmeng County, Hubei Province, deployed substantial police forces in Wuhan and Yunmeng to conduct a synchronized takedown of a black-market gang engaged in anti-collection, proxy rights defense, debt negotiation, and debt optimization activities. Over 40 individuals, including management and key operatives, were apprehended, and 99 forged seals of tertiary hospitals and cancer hospitals nationwide were seized from Zheng's car and residence, along with over 1,700 sets of medical records and a photosensitive seal machine and printer.
